reviews.title: Antalya to Birmingham - 9 hour delay nightmare
reviews.text: How to ruin a luxury holiday: Our excellent 'Indulgent Escapes' holiday to Belek with jet2 was pretty much spoilt by jet2 on our return flight from Antalya to Birmingham. After arriving back at the airport in Turkey via private transfer and going through security everything was on-schedule. Our gate number appeared so my wife and I queued in to the gate along with all the other passengers but we started hearing rumours our flight had been delayed. Until that point no communication from jet2. My wife spotted a single jet2 person and asked them, they confirmed the flight was delayed by weather conditions (thunderstorms). All passengers were told to leave the gate and return to the main terminal area and we started getting texts from jet2 about the delay. Flight got moved to a new gate (gate 215) so we walked there. There seemed to be a lot more people at this new gate than the old gate so we started talking and quickly learnt that at least 2 jet2 flights had been announced at the same gate. With no jet2 staff around to ask I click on the link in the jet2 text which took me to their WhatsApp chat system with their UK customer support team. It would not be unfair of me to say that the person who was chatting to me from jet2 via WhatsApp had absolutely no intention to help. All I was asking was could they contact their UK flight operations team and ask them in turn to contact their staff at Antalya airport and ask them to come to gate 215 to explain to several hundred customers what the delay was and why at least 2 jet2 flights were queuing at the same gate, and was this indeed correct or not? Apparently that simple 'communication' request was too much to ask and I kept being told that they could not help and I should go find a jet2 person myself. It was around that time that an airport security person appeared and started yelling to all of us to leave gate 215 and return to the main airport waiting area/shops area. But just as we headed up the steps in to that area a jet2 person appeared and was shepherding passengers back down the steps and escalator back to the same gate. Another jet2 person appeared, and when confronted about this just told us to return to gate 215 where we waited for several more hours then boarded our flight. Flight crew on board all looked sheepish so I resorted to WhatsApp again, and again no help from jet2 UK customer service team. Air crew started to prepare us for take off only to find that some lunatic was vaping at the back of the plane, so had to wait for him to be dealt with by airport police and offloaded. Plane doors then closed and ready to go, only for the captain to then announce that we are flying to Stansted, due to legal flying hours nearly expiring. But when at Stanstead they'd confirm how to get us to Birmingham. But literally minutes later the captain then corrects that plan and says that the plane is going nowhere and that a replacement aircrew are being flown from the UK (4 hour flight) to Antalya to then fly us home in a 'rescue plane'. We disembarked and returned to the gate whereupon we spotted several familiar faces, these were passengers for a Leeds/Bradford flight which had boarded 15 minutes before us (they'd been queuing with us at the same gate), their flight had taxi'ed then returned to the gate due to the same legal flying hours restriction. But unlike our flight where, having already been delayed 5 hours, and facing at least another 4 hour wait for this 'rescue plane' and crew to arrive, the Leeds/Bradford passengers were told that jet2 would put them in hotel accomodation overnight and fly them home the next morning. I wasn't too happy about this, neither were several other Birmingham passengers, and actually some Leeds passengers weren't happy because they wanted to get home sooner. I get made, what now appears to be a silly error, by phoning Jet2 customer service in the UK to explain the situation, explain my own family's predicament of a 3 hour drive back to Devon once we
reviews.author: Gary H

reviews.title: Avoid
reviews.text: Worst experience ever. I always use jet2 and use to sing their praises. 4 nights in Majorca, ended up being 3 and nearly ended up staying longer.. due to the transfer not showing and had to get a taxi to the airport . Jet2 claiming they have refunded me when they haven’t… 2 months later still not answers or an apology The flight was delayed 12 hours… due to technical difficulties and staffing issues etc No food given, passengers left hours. We got let off the plane and given vouchers however the board stated at the airport it was a final calling, due to me and my friend having just got a table I went to check and was told by a jet 2 staff member you need to go, having left the table me and many other passengers ran to the gate to be told why did we listen to the board I explained we had been told by a jet2 member of staff to come. To be given the response how do you know they worked for jet2, I responded they was in the jet2 uniform So the vouchers we got couldn’t be used so again got on the plane later feeling stressed and having not eaten since the night before. Staff making comments like we’re here from Leeds and we’ve had a long day too and I don’t care I’m going home soon No staff updated us but we was receiving messages on our phone about the delays Finally over 12 hours later we set off and get dropped off streets away from the hotel, given no food at the hotel and wasted an entire day The following day no jet2 rep, nothing. I called and no one discussed us staying longer. Transfer didn’t show and we was left getting a taxi. 2 months later no refund I put a complaint to jet2 to address the issues to receiving no response Please avoid !!! I have flown with jet2 since I was 18 but since having an issue I can see how bad of a company it is due to this the bank have advised I submit a section 75 form in
reviews.author: beckyx0x

reviews.title: Fantastic first experience using Jet2
reviews.text: It was our first time flying with Jet2 & we thought it was fantastic. The online check in is brilliant & really simple to use. The app is great to use & makes things so much easier. We printed our boarding passes at home but there are staff at the airport to help if you haven't. Plenty of Jet2 staff available in the airports to assist if any problems arise. We were updated at all times and received an email into the holiday to tell us the return transfer details etc which i thought was excellent. Coming back we had the free resort check in which is absolutely brilliant and such a great feature. The fights were also really good, plenty of leg room & flight crew coming round often to see if you want drinks, snacks. The crew were really friendly & nothings to much trouble. Will definitely be using Jet2 from now on. Thank you Jet2 for a great experience.
reviews.author: SiPick

reviews.title: First time flying with sunflower lanyard
reviews.text: Just returned a week ago to Bristol after a week in Antalya for a family holiday. My younger daughter (16yrs) flying for the first time after an autism spectrum diagnosis and with a sunflower lanyard round her neck. I cannot praise Jet2 staff enough for the discrete and considerate way that they provided her with support. Airport check-in and onboard staff have clearly been well trained and are committed to applying that training on the ground. Thank you for an excellent experience for my daughter, which meant that the rest of us also had a great time!
reviews.author: Cris B

reviews.title: Family holiday
reviews.text: I have been on many different flights and flown with different airlines, but Jet 2 is by far the worst flight I have ever been on. We have been delayed over an hour because baggage was late being put on the plane. We booked food for our flight and never received it. This is the most uncomfortable flight I have ever been on, I know it’s a low budget airline, but seriously the seats are that hard I had to sit on my neck pillow. I would not recommend this company to fly with. 🤬🤬
reviews.author: Vicky H

reviews.title: Jet2 complaints
reviews.text: Travelled once again with Jet2, experienced some problems with the transfers. Contacted them on arrival back home with our concerns.Complaints team addressed the issue (with the assistance of Althams Pudsey) Quickly, professionally,and with a friendly attitude. Thanks once again for your prompt attention.
reviews.author: mick m

reviews.title: Hotel advertised as soundproof room?Unbeliveable night tram and traffic noise in room.
reviews.text: Great on time flight,spacious seats,plenty leg room,clean cabin,but totally let down by a appartment hotel that advertise as sound proof room. We booked a suite,superb,but barely slept due to traffic noise and early morning all day building renovations next door, never advised of this,told reception but no response. After sight seeing every day we wanted to relax,rest and sleep but found we could only cat nap.as continuosly woken by trams which ran throughout the night,and load cars and bikes.
reviews.author: christine s

reviews.title: Miss sold my holiday by jet 2 and extra leg room seats a joke
reviews.text: Firstly we had been looking and looking to no decide as to where to go on our stag do group if 5 and prices were flying up so I thought a would ring trusted company like just 2 to advise us with the budget we had 350 each but wanted to be somewhere lively with lots of bars n a couple of clubs . They advised the hsm canarios park for. Groupe if 5 stags advising a STRIP with in a km of the hotel.. the closest bars were more restraunts with no night life past 11 o clock couldn't even get a taxi back after that time 1.8km away and am a big chap can't walk much further than 1km so I struggled... the place a more a children n family resort very bad advise given by this company the hotel must be a high profit resort to Jet2 and they were thinking of there pockets rather than our holiday... If you don't like fish you will struggle eating there am ok but the lads ate out 3 days of four as basic food and very repeated... Drinks were great how ever . TV in the room did now work either . We payed extra for extra leg room and got a high traffic walk way from one side of the plane to another if your on a wide plane with 4 seats in middle u will be a walk way for all the passengers and staff did very little to stop people using our seats as a crossing to Point to the vacant toilet on other side of plane verry disappointed jet 2
reviews.author: Christopher F

reviews.title: Holiday and flight Lanzarote
reviews.text: Excellent service from booking (last November) to coming home. Spreading the cost is brilliant in todays climate, flexible length of stay also helps. a lot of staff in airport and lots of check in desks makes a speedy flow through airport. Have used Jet2 many times now and will aways go to them first for holidays abroad.
reviews.author: Hefin W

reviews.title: jet2 beats TUI every time!
reviews.text: Firstly we made the mistake of trying TUI this year, what a disaster! I read jet2 negative reviews and they mainly complain about stuff that is beyond or not in jet2's remit/control. Example...transfer bus staff or the food at a hotel, yes inform a jet2 rep...but they have no control over that!!! What jet2 have control of is your check in and gate experience, your aircraft flight and landing and showing you which bus to board. Baggage handling is done by an outfit like Swissport not jet2 for example. In closing most people on here complaining are too lazy to separate out their complaints to each organisation and just lump it on one service provider instead! Example too many loud kids on a plane with smelly nappies...that is the parents fault not the flight crew's!
reviews.author: The Great One!

reviews.title: Vanessa - Rep at Theo Sunset Bay Hotel Cyprus
reviews.text: All I can say is WOW 6 of us just spent 11 nights at Theo Sunset Bay Hotel in Cyprus, (14/6/23 - 25/6/23) the hotel in general was beautiful but the one person that made it was Vanessa (not sure on her surname). Nothing was too much trouble for Vanessa and she always made time to say hello and have a chat even when she was busy. She is a credit to your enormous team and we could not have wished for a better rep. Massive thank you once again to Vanessa you are a ⭐️
reviews.author: loobylou12016

reviews.title: Worst Service ever!!  Don't book Jet2!!
reviews.text: 2hr Delay at Edinburgh Airport,, absoultley chaos on the plan.... Half items on menu were out of stock.... landed at Antalya and we're put on a transfer bus and made to wait 2hrs in a car park. We were told that someone had lost their luggage. Our bus was full and a lot of young kids and after 2hrs (nearly 2am), the lost luggage family never appeared and we left. I NEVER AGAIN
reviews.author: Nomad690620

reviews.title: Excellent Experience
reviews.text: Went on a flight with Jet 2 and as a nervous flyer , I found the air stewards very helpful reassuring me and checking I was okay. Good leg room on the flight. Will fly with them again
reviews.author: Wendy H

reviews.title: Special mention to Ciara
reviews.text: Travelled back last night from Tenerife to Manchester on the LS918 flight. All the cabin crew were really friendly and tried their best to cater for all passengers despite limited food available due to demand. Would like to mention how friendly Ciara was and how apologetic she was with the limited supplies despite it being out of her control. I met a couple on the flight out and was next to them on the return flight and their little boy started to get nervous mid flight. Ciara was exceptional in reassuring the little lad and offered the parents any further support they need. Really top class customer service that shouldn’t go unrecognised!
reviews.author: Scotty

reviews.title: Very well organised
reviews.text: Very well organised , staff were professional polite and very helpful on board as well as the ground staff, our only critique would be that the seats are a little too hard and become uncomfortable after a short while they really need a bit more padding ,it would seem that the airline has spoilt the ship for a haypath of Tar . That aside Jet2 have it spot on and i for one would not hesitate to use them again .
reviews.author: toonfc

reviews.title: annoying
reviews.text: the song gets annoying at times as i was trying to sleep with my baby with me it made her cry the crew were lovey
reviews.author: hotels and airlines reviews

reviews.title: Fantastic Customer Service in a Crisis
reviews.text: On our Transfer home our Bag got stolen with Passports and IPads Wallet etc Didn’t realise until we got on Transfer Coach back to Airport on taking seat The Courier Turned back to Hotel to see if it was handed in, on realising it had been stolen He phoned the Jet 2 staff at Airport On arrival there was a representative waiting her name was Kayle as I was getting off coach I received a phone call from the Hotel saying the Bag had been found and handed to the Police only knowing that our Passports were still in there Kayle helped us to sort out what we needed to do and sorted out a return flight in 2 days to give us time to get the passports back then arranged for us to get another coach back to Hotel Jet 2 phoned me the next day to ask if we was ok They was so concerned and kind And text us information I would definitely use them again
reviews.author: Jan

reviews.title: All crew great
reviews.text: My friend and I flew with jet 2 19 .06.23 and I can honestly say the staff were very friendly and always there to help and big smiles the flights were great a credit to your pilots and also cabin crew. Coming back as well no issues with anything again pure professionals. I needed a break so this was short notice to book as I have a brain tumour which is inoperable so this made the journeys great for me.
reviews.author: Tracy B

reviews.title: Would not recommend
reviews.text: The staff needs upgrading , the plane was not clean at all , the chairs or shall I call the benches where uncomfortable.
reviews.author: Johnrolita

reviews.title: Excellent service.
reviews.text: We travelled on 5th June to Madeira. We couldn't land in Madeira due to wind and low cloud. The pilot tried his best, but we had to divert to Gran Canaria. Jet 2 got us a hotel, and we stayed overnight. We had breakfast and lunch the next day, and I had regular messages from them. We flew the next evening, and we were lucky as we had a short break in the weather. We landed at 9.30pm, and the airport was closed at midnight, and was closed all day Wednesday due to storm Oscar. My wife had broken her leg before we flew, and she was given passenger assist. Both Newcastle and Madeira staff were brilliant. I cannot praise them enough. 10/10.
reviews.author: Razza

reviews.title: Db- June 2023
reviews.text: Have only ever heared good things about jet 2. Having used them once before. However this time was a disaster from start to finish. Delayed on our departure flight with no acknowledgment from staff. To be waiting at Antalya airport foe nearly 2 hours for baggage. Coming home- transfer late which made us late for airport with having not eaten with 2 young children. 45 mins of waiting was then told flight was delayed for 2 hours. Was really shocked at the service provided by jet2. Also when boarding the plane asked to get boarding cards out again after walking from getting boarding cards a checked before boarding the plane 🙈 this delays passengers getting to their seats more quickly. Also I now have damaged brand new suitcases from where staff have obviously thrown them on for collection!
reviews.author: danielle091927

reviews.title: Above and beyond
reviews.text: I would really like to thanks you desk staff at your Fuerteventura airport. We had a family emergency and need to get back to the U.K. it was late in the day and we had gone past the internet and phone flight booking time. Your staff were absolutely brilliant and a credit to Jet2. The care they took with us to get us on the flight was above and beyond. If you could pass on our thanks, it was on 19.30 12th June. Thanks Paul.
reviews.author: P.G.

reviews.title: Yet another great flight
reviews.text: Have used Jet2 for our 4 recent holidays. However this was definitely the best. No problems with check and casino crew especially Rose and Lewis were very welcoming and friendly throughout flight. Would never fly by any other airline. Keep up the good work
reviews.author: Ian B

reviews.title: Robert Torrence
reviews.text: Flight was fine. Unfortunately on route to my apartment the Rep got off the coach and the stop before my apartment. The bus driver dumped my luggage on the pavement and drove off. The apartment gates were locked and reception was closed. I had to wait on the pavement until 3am. Lucky for me the security from the hotel next door happened to pass me and eventually he contacted the security from my apartments who eventually turned up to let me in. I was there for 14 days and didn't see the Rep once because I wanted to book excursions through them. There was no notice board either. After 12 days I had a txt to inform me that I was being picked up at ANOTHER hotel. I would not use Jet2 ever again. Absolute shambles!!!
reviews.author: Robert Torrence
reviews.route: Manchester - Las Palmas de Gran Canaria

reviews.title: 1.5 hour baggage delay
reviews.text: Lack of Jet2 staff working at Manchester Airport, results in 1.5 hour delay for bags coming off plane. Won't fly Jet2 again due to this, there really is no excuse.
reviews.author: Chris1982-09

reviews.text: Terrible seats, no room, seats don't recline at at all, very uncomfortable journey. Rep at resortno help, i told don't get commission on this excursion, book it yourself.
reviews.author: Steve H
reviews.route: London - Las Palmas de Gran Canaria

reviews.title: Famously friendly?????
reviews.text: To start I have to say the staff at the airport on arrival were brilliant, however on the plane (both directions) was a different matter. I hate not being greeted on the plane, I was always say Hello, how are you to cabin crew, not a response back. Then there was the prerecorded message that they were about to start their famously friendly service was about to start. Is there an extra charge for this?? Not one smile among the grumpiest cabin crew I have come across.
reviews.author: Rob C

reviews.title: Ground Staff
reviews.text: This review is for the ground staff in Skiathos airport. Angela (angellika) is an asset for your Company. We arrived early at the airport and was greeted and kept totally informed by the aforementioned person. Seems really keen. Keep your good staff.
reviews.author: Paul M

reviews.title: Worst Customer service with staff who lie in an attempt to fob you off !
reviews.text: Poor instruction re pick up point resulting in missed return coach trip. Lied to about pick up by customer service staff who stated other customers were there and got on the coach !! Lies lies lies , We were the only pick up at that point which we had confirmed prior to our departure flight by staff at the airport ( and admitted by customer service manager that we had been lied to) !! Also paid for own taxi with no refund and no apology for poor communication , basically calling us liars.
reviews.author: Franco3906

reviews.title: Lovely Petra
reviews.text: We have just decided to visit Petra, Lesvos again this year but have left it a bit late, but availability to Petra is zero, would be nice to have more choice of hotels in central Petra as they get booked up quickly. We love Petra and Anaxos have been about 20 times can't wait to return with the amazing jet2.
reviews.author: Jennifer M

reviews.title: Big shout out to supervisor Neil at Stansted
reviews.text: Neil helped find my headphones left on a flight. I knew I had dropped them on the plane and I was going to run back and get them but Jet 2 staff told me to go through security and pick them up on the ground side. What initially sounded very simple, was in fact, not. Customer services knew I was coming as they said “is this about the headphones” but after some back and forth on the radio the headphones seemed to go missing. No one could give me an answer and I eventually had to leave the airport. Lost property were no help and the number for baggage just told me to register with first flight (lost property). It was a chicken and egg situation. Eventually after many of my persistent calls I spoke to Neil, gave him the headphones sob story and he said leave with him and he’ll figure it out. Within a few hours he came back to me and had found them. I’m not sure why they never made it to ground side or were never sent to lost property but we got there in the end. He then kept a hold of them until I was able to collect. Big thanks Neil! Much appreciated. Give this guy a raise for a top customer service job. Oh and also the holiday was pretty good too 😁
reviews.author: Anya

reviews.title: Carol
reviews.text: Lovely staff lovely flight, no complaints whats so ever , in fact I’ve traveled all over the world and the landing coming home was the best I’ve ever known .. didn’t realise we had landed tbh and I was next to the window, wouldn’t hesitate to fly with them again .
reviews.author: carol c

reviews.title: Not too bad
reviews.text: I’ve never flown with Jet 2 before always flown with Tui I would have given them 5 stars had the flight not been delayed both ways what I can say is that their communication at every level ( email, text , at the airport ,on the plane , on their app at the hotel ) is absolutely brilliant and very quick efficient check in professional a very well organised airline 👏🏾👏🏾👏🏾 Tui could learn a lot from them !!
reviews.author: Clair Graham

reviews.title: Brilliant 👍
reviews.text: Absolutely fantastic service, would recommend anyone to fly with them. Super impressed with communication and after a lost passport in the airport, their understanding and friendliness. Thank you Jet2, you were great 👍
reviews.author: Liz J

reviews.title: Group Trip
reviews.text: What a great airline. No queues at check in at either Stansted or Faro because they had all desks fully staffed. Staff really friendly and welcoming. other airlines could learn a lot from their approach.
reviews.author: joewallis1962

reviews.title: Very good
reviews.text: As always we recieved very good customer service with Jet2. The flights out and back were both late but this was due to ATC. Check in was an absolute breeze (there was no queue) and there were plenty of staff available to help with check in. The lady thay helped us was super friendly and helpful. The other Jet 2 ground staff were all very polite and friendly. Onboard the pilots gave detailed and regular updates and on our return journey kept us updated throughout the delay which is always appreciated. Cabin crew were generally very friendly and very efficient.
reviews.author: Daniel V

reviews.title: Building Works in the Hotel next
reviews.text: Contacted by Jet2 just 60 hours before we going to fly to sat that their ongoing building works at the hotel next door. Although they. presumably knew about this at the time of our booking. As the scale of refurbishment is at visible from satellite images on google maps, the incompetency of their managed on not allowing any contingency for works being delayed. Calling the contact centre and although their staff are friendly and well drilled on brand values. The policies, processes and incompetency of their senior management means they are powerless to help. Option’s we currently have… 1) wait til you get there and see how ‘bad’ it is… we have a 24 hotline (this is there recommended option) 2) escalate a complaint. Sounds promising we aim to contact you in 72 hours. 3) Pay full cancellation fees to transfer to another hotel. Luckily Jet2 are happy to waive their admin fee due to their competency. Jet2 claim to be a responsible tour operator, as per the email. Although claiming to be inform us of a change. This is incorrect! Their work has been going since we booked and will be continuing whilst we are on holiday. A ‘responsible’ tour operator would have informed at the point of booking or before we were tied into cancellation fees. So we could have made our own decision. Luckily our 23 month old daughter will be gracefully unaware and will have the time of her life, unfortunately we won’t get the relaxation we’d hoped from the LUX Collection.
reviews.author: John-Paul B

reviews.title: Agreed to refund flights but didn't then lied
reviews.text: After booking a flight at an airport then realising I couldn't fly Jet2 agreed to refund the flight 2 hours after booking. The agent who I booked this with had wrongly input my details unfortunately 2gicb has caused a refund issue. Even though I confirmed with jet 2 that they were to refund the flight they directed me to my bank as the refund did not arrive back on my card after 2 weeks (I'm guessing due to the wrong details they entered at the point of booking). When my bank contacted jet2 they disputed the refund and they even lied saying I used the flight when my passport was in another country at the time of the flight.
reviews.author: Donnie B

reviews.title: Great holiday package experience
reviews.text: We booked a holiday package with Jet2 and would definitely reccommend. Before we set off, everything was clearly outlined in the app and checking in online was straightforward. Security and everything else at the airport itself was time consuming, but that's not because of Jet2. The flight went smoothly and had friendly staff, comfy seats and reasonably priced food and drink. The luggage limits were big, too. The only downside was no in flight entertainment- but it was only a 4 hour flight, maybe they offer that with longer ones. We had private transfers from the airport to the hotel. They were mini buses just for 3 of us! Very comfy and on time. The hotel was great and there was a Jet2 rep in the reception almost every day, as well as a whats app number you are given to use if you need anything (alongside a phone number). I travelled with my husband and 7 year old son and we will travel with Jet2 again.
reviews.author: Ruby - Laura C

reviews.title: Awful seats
reviews.text: Seats are the most uncomfortable seats in the world , arm rests are for people with no arms. Awful painful experiences.
reviews.author: Richard B

reviews.title: Julie Buxton Jet2 call handler
reviews.text: Julie Buxton works for Jet2 airline I had the pleasure of her being my call handler this morning she went over and above to sort out my problem she was good and so helpful and friendly and made me feel like a really valued customer I hope there are more staff at Jet2 like Julie because she was the best I have ever had to deal with
reviews.author: gerda9966

reviews.title: Great service
reviews.text: Great customer service and would always travel with them. However, we arrived at our resort around midnight with 2 children in tow. The coach dropped us off and gave us a map the find our Villas. We had no idea where we were going and had to ask several times. The Villas were between 2 restaurants but was not clearly sign posted and it did take us a while to find them. Am sure Jet 2 could try and find an alternative smaller coach to get us there as it was not good walking streets with 2 young children at that time.
reviews.author: Christine B

reviews.title: Symphony of crying kids
reviews.text: Just came back from a week in the nice turkish sun . The filght was a downside to the trip , delayed both ways , waiting and long que due to lake of orgnisation , seat was very un confy , the food was expensive and not nice . £2 for 300m of water that is too much . The worse of it all so many crying kids both ways ?! I know it not the kids fault or the pearnts then it must be the air lines mistake or the customer you tel me .
reviews.author: mohammed a

reviews.title: Mid term holiday trip
reviews.text: A very expensive holiday that did not meet expectations or leave us at all like we had a holiday. 5star hotel was nice but not at the level as promised and flights were at such horrible times made worse by delays that it left a sour taste for the whole trip. A real disappointment given the promise of the holiday and the level of customer service received for booking. Another example of overselling with no real option for recourse once purchased. Anyway, will be sorting own holidays from now, cheaper and more flexible.
reviews.author: Tim S

reviews.title: Never again
reviews.text: We will never fly with jet2 again , having checked every flight up to 3 weeks before we were due to fly and they all departed late ! Not just 10minutes mostly 45 minutes to an hour . Never flying with Jet2 again .
reviews.author: Manilow26

reviews.title: Flight with family to Menorca
reviews.text: Flew out from LBA to Mahon on May 30th using special assistance for myself,accompanied by may daughter,son in law and 2 young granddaughters.Fantastic flight,staff were amazing and the special assistance for myself was flawless.Boarding was quick,the plane was immaculate and the flight time of 2 hours 19 minutes great,thanks JET2
reviews.author: lifesagag123

reviews.title: Went like clockwork
reviews.text: This is the second time I've had a package deal with JET2 and on both occasions I've had little to nothing to complain about. This time no delays either way, in fact arrived back 35 mins early. Glad to see the bucket seats are gone so didn't need the padded pants and cushion I brought after being in agony 5 years ago when I last flew with them. JET2 staff at airport to guide us to transfer coaches and on time pick-up on the way back. Hotel was as advertised. Will definitely use them again. Refreshing to get good customer service for a change.
reviews.author: Wanderer683075
reviews.route: Newcastle upon Tyne - Palma de Mallorca

reviews.title: Pollensa Spa hotel
reviews.text: Excellent holiday. Relaxing holiday due to smooth transfers to hotel, excellent food and drink with variety and plenty to choose from in all inclusive deal. Rooms clean and spacious with fridge and beautiful Seaview. Enjoyed yoga and aqua zumba and hired bike from hotel to explore next town when weather wasn't as favourable. Staff helpful and friendly. Rep helpful. Had to get son antibiotics for tonsillitis. Easily sorted through pharmacy and medical centre with healthcare card. Would thoroughly recommend.
reviews.author: mummy g

reviews.title: Do not trust the price shown - easyJet holidays saved us
reviews.text: We started booking a weeks holiday in October (we're in June now) with friends to celebrate a number of 40th birthdays together. We started booking at the same time. After the first booking was confirmed, 30 seconds later, the next booking could not complete. When the holiday search restarted the holiday went up by £400 per family. We called Jet2 with the hope the prices on the 2nd booking would be honoured however we were informed its a live system and the price will change with every booking. This was disappointing as the booking process had started, the price at the start of booking wasn't honoured and the travel agent could do nothing for us other than apologise. We obviously still wanted to travel as a group and didn't want our friends to pay the hefty new price. So we had to cancel our 15 minute old booking at a cost of £60 per person. We are absolutely flabbergasted at this poor customer service. In the mean time our friend found the exact same holiday on Easy Jet holiday for £100 per person less. Which luckily made up for our admin fee. This has left a sour taste for us as we feel like the system cannot be trusted as the price quoted was not honoured.
